caracteristicas: Mega Menace contains a total of 20 No Continues levels, called On Mighty Wings Lvs. After beating three On Mighty Wings Lvs, the player must wait for 30 minutes before they may proceed to the next one (may have 3 clears after 90 minutes). Rewards for the first completion of an On Mighty Wings Lv can include XP, Tickets, Catamins and Materials. Every 10 On Mighty Wings Lvs plays out the same, but the strength magnifications and enemy base's HP are increased with each level.

Tag Arena Challenge (タッグ闘技チャレンジ, Taggu Tōgi Charenji, Tag Team Challenge) is a map added in Version 11.6. It consists of all Tag Arena Stages combined into a single map, along with three new stages. Progress made in Tag Arena Challenge will reset when the event ends.
There are three stages per map, each with a Cat Deploy Limit and enemy limit of 2. Taking over 15 minutes to beat any stage will cause an Assassin Bear to spawn. As opposed to the Duel Stages Challenge, most of the enemies can spawn multiple times.
No info :) this is a Gamatoto expedition area that gives Catseyes as rewards.

caracteristicas: Ranking Dojo (ネコ道場ランキングイベント, Neko Dōjō Rankingu Ibento, Cat Dojo Ranking Event) is an event that first appeared from July 31st to August 7th, 2017. This event was officially added in the Version 6.3 Update. The Ranking Dojo is accessed from the Catclaw Dojo menu, so the player needs to unlock the Catclaw Dojo feature in order to participate by completing Chapter 1 of Empire of Cats.

Gigahaniwan Strikes! contains a total of 20 No Continues levels, called Excavation Lvs. After beating an Excavation Lv, the player must wait for 30 minutes before they may proceed to the next one. The player may choose to bank up to 3 Excavation Lvs at one time by waiting for 90 minutes, allowing them to beat all 3 Lvs at one go. Rewards for the first completion of an Excavation Lv can include XP, Tickets, Catamins and Materials. Every 10 Excavation Lvs plays out the same, but the strength magnifications and enemy base's HP are increased with each level.

Legend Quest is a map somewhat similar to Heavenly Tower, with 48 stages known as LEVELs. Each LEVEL is a random Stories of Legend stage that provides a partially randomized lineup. All LEVELs are No Continues, and exiting a battle within 10 seconds will not refund items, Crowns or energy.
